conditions: one player, magic find 0, gold find 0; item level = the unit's level (stat 12); rolls are game.exe's FUN_0055a6d0 natively under the emulator (V run)
units: every value is an expected COUNT of dropped items: per_clear = whole area once; per_1000_kills = per 1000 kills; per_min = per_clear / clear_min (clear_min is the TIME MODEL of areaxp.csv, I). Gold is excluded (docs/research/xp-gold-trace.md).

keys.potion_hpN / potion_mpN: healing / mana potion of tier N (1 minor .. 5 super); potion_hp and potion_mp are the sums; potion_rejuv rejuvenation (small and full); potion_other stamina, antidote, thawing
keys.gem_<grade>, gem, rune, rune_low, rune_h: gems by grade, all runes, runes r01..r10 and r11+
keys.gear_<quality>: weapons and armor by quality: plain (low and normal), superior, magic, rare, set, unique
keys.gear_<early|mid|late>_<quality>: the same by base levelreq: early <= 10, mid 11..25, late > 25 (strength and dexterity not modelled, U)
keys.jewelry_*, jewel_any, charm: rings and amulets by quality, jewels, charms
keys.magic_plus, rare_plus, set_unique: all items (gear, jewelry, jewels, charms) of magic or better, rare or better, set or unique
keys.gear_usable25_magic_plus: weapons and armor of magic or better quality on early or mid bases (a clvl 15..25 hero)
